pages.title: Cicada Guide connector
pages.text: Cicada Guide connector Cicada Guide connector Research U.S. state legislation from ChatGPT: find bills and read their text, see who sponsored them and how each roll call went, and look up state legislators, their voting records and how to contact them. Read-only; no account needed. Add it to ChatGPT In ChatGPT Plugins, choose Add custom MCP server, enter this host followed by /mcp-openai , and select No authentication. Install the connection and select it in a new chat. Connection instructions Try asking Brief me on Alabama HB 314. What bills in Georgia mention school funding this session? How did my state senator vote on the budget? How do I contact Alabama Representative Rex Reynolds? Break down the final passage vote on that bill by party. What you'll see ChatGPT shows four interactive cards: A bill card: summary, path to becoming law, sponsors, documents and floor votes. Bill search results. A legislator's voting record. A contact card. Bill documents open on their first page, with a button to read them full screen. Limits State legislatures only: not the U.S. Congress, local governments or ballot measures. Some roll calls have no individual votes on record; they show as not recorded, never as 0–0. Research support, not an authoritative legal record. More Privacy policy Support (GitHub issues)

pages.title: Cicada Guide connector: privacy
pages.text: Cicada Guide connector: privacy Privacy policy: Cicada Guide connector Last updated: 2026-11-02. Scope This policy covers the Cicada Guide connector (MCP server) on this host, which answers questions about U.S. state legislation for AI assistants such as ChatGPT. The Cicada Guide website and app are covered by cicada.guide/privacy-policy . Optional analytics PostHog analytics are disabled unless the operator configures a project token. When enabled, tool calls record the following: The tool's name and the arguments your assistant passed. context : a short note your assistant writes about the purpose of the call. When it writes none, the connector records a generic one built from the tool's purpose and the names of the arguments passed, never their values. llm_model : the name of the AI model making the call. conversation_id : a random identifier the connector issues on a call and your assistant passes back on the next ones, so calls from one conversation are grouped together. It is generated by the connector and holds nothing from your conversation. The app making the call: its name and version, and the User-Agent string it sends. How long the call took, the size of the response, and any error. The arguments can include text taken from your conversation, such as a search phrase or the summary shown on a bill card. The connector does not record your conversation beyond the context note and those arguments, and it does not record the results it sends back. The connector also lists a get_more_tools tool. It returns no data: when your assistant calls it, the connector records the assistant's note on what it was trying to do and what tool would have helped, to show which tools are missing. When analytics are enabled, connections and unexpected refused or failed requests may be recorded with client details and without tool arguments. Tool and resource list events are dropped. No sign-in events are collected. Who is identified All calls are anonymous and are recorded without a person profile. This server has no sign-in or account identification. Where it goes PostHog (United States), for product analytics. Cloudflare, which hosts the connector, keeps request logs, which can include your IP address and the approximate location Cloudflare derives from it, and applies rate limits by IP address. The legislative data comes from public records, and nothing about you is written to it. What is never collected No email address or phone number, and no precise location. The district map's location toggle runs in your browser and is never sent. Nothing is sold or used for advertising. Retention Analytics events are kept for up to 7 years. Request logs are kept for a few days. Contact Questions or requests: GitHub issues . Cicada Guide connector

pages.title: cicada.guide - Track Legislation & Contact Representatives
pages.text: cicada.guide - Track Legislation & Contact Representatives About Features Help & support Get started Buzz Data Plugin Understand state legislation and contact your representatives Engaged citizens, informed leaders, and a better democracy. Get started About Cicada Building the infrastructure for democracy in the 21st century Cicada gives people accessible, actionable information about state legislation. It turns legal language into clear summaries and helps citizens communicate with elected leaders. The goal is simple: make meaningful participation possible regardless of someone’s political knowledge or technical experience. Summarize Read legislation in plain English cicada.guide combines AI with community feedback to turn complex legislation into clear summaries that explain a bill’s practical impact. Summaries are informational and don’t replace the official bill text. advocate Contact your representatives Share why a bill matters to you, in your own words, and send it to the representatives who can act. Your message goes out through your own email, text, or phone. organize Stay informed about legislation that matters to you Use personalized, discovery, and tracking feeds to find new bills and follow the legislation you care about. For You Get recommendations for new legislation based on preferences. Discover See the latest legislation for your chosen subjects. Tracking Track legislation that you have starred and their progress. Transparency & accountability Track your representative's votes and how they align with your values See how your representatives have voted on various issues, offering a clear view of their legislative actions. Get a percentage score for how often their votes aligned with your values. Select the score to toggle between all bills and just tracked bills. research Research state legislation with your AI assistant Connect any AI assistant that supports MCP to cicada.guide's legislative data at public.cicada.guide/mcp-anthropic. Search bills, read bill text, look up legislators, and trace roll-call votes. No account needed. Set it up Ready to get started? Get started Get in touch Privacy Policy Terms & Conditions Disclaimer
